repos_data.description: The headless FinOps intelligence layer: API-first, agent-first cost control for cloud + AI. Connect your cloud stack in Claude, Cursor, or the terminal, and gate what agents do to your infra before they act. Propose-only. Open source, local-first.
MCP server that compares on-demand VM pricing across AWS, Azure, and GCP in real time
Anchor AI FinOps to real, live cloud pricing — open source MCP server for AWS, GCP, and Azure
Multi-cloud cost management MCP server (Azure + GCP). Read-only access to spending, anomalies, forecasts, budgets, and guided FinOps workflows. Ask your AI about your cloud bill.
AI-powered cloud architecture - describe infrastructure in natural language, get Terraform, cost estimates, and compliance reports
Powerful open-source CLI to audit security, costs, and best practices in AWS. 🩺 ☁️
A detective for your data. Zero-config data quality monitoring — works with dbt, Postgres, BigQuery, Snowflake. No YAML.
Blockchain event sequence anomaly detection MCP server. Scores event streams using NASA-derived SequenceMiner via x402 micropayments.
The open-source policy-as-code software that provides analysis for Multi-Cloud and SaaS environments, you can get insight with natural language (powered by OpenAI).
Fast, opinionated AWS security scanner. Curated checks. Zero noise. Copy-paste fixes.
Python SDK for WaveGuard  physics-based anomaly detection API. One call. Any data.
Model Context Protocol server for Cloud Infrastructure pricing information

repo_meta_data.description: Detects structural waste in cloud billing exports (AWS/GCP/Azure) using rolling-median + MAD, robust to the masking effect that breaks mean+stddev anomaly detection. Python library, CLI, FastAPI service, and GitHub Action.
